description: AbstractEndpoint class defines a base class for Hono service endpoints, managing Vert.x instance, tracing, lifecycle methods, and health check registration.

classes.name: AbstractEndpoint
classes.description: Base class for Hono endpoints, providing lifecycle management, tracing setup, and health check registration.

methods.name: AbstractEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing with Vertx instance, ensuring non-null.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing Tracer; defaults to NoopTracer if not provided.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the endpoint, calling doStart; returns a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement startup resource creation; default completes immediately.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the endpoint, calling doStop; returns a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement shutdown resource release; default completes immediately.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Method for subclasses to register liveness health checks; default does nothing.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Method for subclasses to register readiness health checks; default does nothing.

methods.name: createEventBusMessageDeliveryOptions
methods.description: Creates DeliveryOptions with injected SpanContext for message tracing.
